title: New research reveals limitations of vendor advisories in identifying critical security vulnerabilities
summary: Per Infosecurity Magazine, 88% of critical and high-severity vulnerabilities identified during live attack simulations this year would have remained undetected by relying solely on vendor advisories or external intelligence sources.
why_it_matters: Exploit-ready vulnerabilities can rapidly translate into compromise—especially for internet-facing services and widely deployed products.
recommendation: Prioritize patching/mitigations, review exposure, and add detection for exploitation attempts (e.g., WAF/EDR signatures and logs).
